reviewKind: Manual source review plus read-only hashes and whitespace; no runtime or compilation

checks.invariant: Every transfer is a paired swap of packed material and energy; no reseeding
checks.basis: Unique source coordinates plus a constant offset give an injective destination mapping; both domains are staged before publication

checks.invariant: Damage/internal bonds travel; external bonds and anchors require explicit policies
checks.basis: Reciprocal cuts precede swapping; both outputs use existing validateStructuralState3D; displaceable targets have zero structure

checks.invariant: Temporary pins cannot be implicitly transferred or displaced
checks.basis: Overlay participates in obstruction checks; held sources reject; temporary overlay is stripped before canonical publication

checks.invariant: Snapshots own bounded storage and preserve absolute domain ticks
checks.basis: Strict data descriptors and arrays, aggregate cells checked before M5 copy, matching versions/tick, canonical IDs and stable restore topology

checks.invariant: No partly advanced inventory reaches a game policy or live commit
checks.basis: Sequential driver loop stages every domain, validates each completed output, then invokes reducer and updates private working snapshot

checks.invariant: Partial construction and cleanup errors close every available driver
checks.basis: Created drivers are tracked before checkpoint; closeAll pops each and collects errors; any failure discards branch

notProven: Type correctness, compilation and test assertions
Actual physical domain trajectories or exact runtime replay
